faq.contact: Can't find what you are looking for? Write to us at {email}

items.a: No. Sanadak is a tool that assists the lawyer in understanding cases and finding weak points in seconds, and it does not replace the lawyer.

items.q: How does Sanadak help a lawyer day to day?
items.a: It cuts the time spent searching legal texts to seconds, helps you find defences and read and analyse contracts and reports, and puts the article behind each answer in front of you. You spend your time on case strategy instead of looking things up.

items.q: Where does Sanadak get its answers?
items.a: From the Egyptian legislation loaded into its text database. Each answer shows the articles it relied on, so you can review them yourself before relying on them.

The current content includes major laws such as the Civil Code, the Penal Code, the Code of Criminal Procedure and the Law on the Legal Profession, and it grows as new legislation is added. If the article you ask about is not in the database, Sanadak says so instead of guessing.

items.q: Does Sanadak write full legal memos?
items.a: Sanadak is an assistant, not a replacement for the lawyer. It supplies the texts and defences relevant to your case and suggests a suitable structure, but the final drafting stays with the lawyer who knows the details of the case.

items.q: Are my conversations and documents confidential?
items.a: Your conversations are saved in your account and no other user can reach them, and you can delete any conversation at any time. The answering model runs on our servers.

items.q: Can I upload a contract or a report for review?
items.a: Yes. Attach a document or a scanned image and ask Sanadak about its terms or your legal position based on it.
Yes. Arabic is the primary language, and you can switch to English from the top of the page. Legal texts stay in their official language, with an unofficial translation.

features.title: What Sanadak offers
features.intro: Tools that save a lawyer hours of research and preparation, with every result tied to its source text.

items.title: Smart search across the laws
items.body: Find the right article in the legislation and the commentaries in seconds.

items.title: Strengths and weaknesses
items.body: Reads the case papers and shows what strengthens your position and what weakens it.

items.title: Suggested defences
items.body: Suggests the defences that fit the facts of the case.

items.title: Anticipated counter-defences
items.body: Foresees what the other side may raise so you can prepare for it.

items.title: Missing evidence
items.body: Points out the documents and evidence the case file still lacks.

items.title: Statements of claim and defence memos
items.body: Prepares a draft for you to review and edit before filing.

items.title: Every result tied to texts and Court of Cassation rulings
items.body: Each result points to the article that supports it and to relevant Court of Cassation rulings.

items.title: Drafting every kind of contract
items.body: Drafts contracts of all kinds in precise legal language.

items.title: Contract review and amended clauses
items.body: Reviews a contract and proposes clause changes in your client's interest.
